title: Lewdness
grade_or_penalty: Disorderly persons offense; 4th degree if the exposure is to a child under 13 (or a person unable to understand) for sexual gratification
key_points: Doing a flagrantly lewd and offensive act knowing or reasonably expecting it will be seen by a nonconsenting person who would be affronted or alarmed.
elements: The suspect did a flagrantly lewd and offensive act
Knowing or reasonably expecting it would be observed by a nonconsenting person who would be affronted or alarmed
For the 4th-degree version: exposed intimate parts for sexual gratification to a child under 13 (or a person unable to understand), with the actor at least 4 years older

subsections.label: a
subsections.text: Lewdness: a flagrantly lewd and offensive act knowing or expecting it will be observed by a nonconsenting person who would be affronted or alarmed

subsections.label: b
subsections.text: Exposes intimate parts for sexual gratification to a child under 13 (actor 4+ years older) or a person unable to understand; or similar conduct listed
